STRICT FRONT VIEW, symmetric neutral standing fit with natural vertical gravity. ONLY ONE garment, no person, skin, face, limbs, mannequin, hanger, props, jewelry, text or sheet. Complete all hidden parts including waistband or shoulder/armhole construction. True transparent background, no cast shadow, no glow or haze around the edges, no shiny satin highlights. Keep all garment parts connected where physically connected. Fully visible garment with small clear margins. Design: an adult university daily one-piece pinafore dress outfit: a muted slate-blue high square-bib pinafore with broad shoulder straps over an opaque ivory short-sleeve high-collar blouse, fitted natural waist, subtle front patch pockets and A-line midi skirt, matte fabrics, no bow or insignia. The dress must cover the chest and broad shoulder areas so pale-blue sports-bra straps from the reference cannot show through. Waist seam easy to identify, no low neckline, no thin spaghetti straps.
